thread:
Ava Martinez: ok who's the genius who put a 'tera-flop' sticker on the espresso machine? :joy:
Liam Chen: not me, but 10/10 branding decision. also the machine now smells faintly of Python and regret :coffee:
Noah Patel: found the sticker, it was behind the milk frother. someone left a tiny SSD in the drip tray too, pls stop leaving hardware near hot liquids 😬
Ava Martinez: SSD in the drip tray? that's how you get flaky IO, not flaky croissants. meme incoming.
Liam Chen: uploading pic: espresso-chip.jpg (very professional) :laughing:
DeployBot: FYI CI build/validator-3587 failed on lint in runtime/batcher.py, rerun with --fix?
Liam Chen: great timing DeployBot, the meme has its own SLO now — delivery within 2 mins of coffee spill.
Noah Patel: design idea: T-shirt that says 'I survived a noisy neighbor and an espresso incident' with a little GPU icon. Ava you down to doodle? attachment: espresso-sketch.png
Ava Martinez: love it. also someone please write a unit test for the espresso machine: ```assert not in_dishwasher(espresso_chip)```
Liam Chen: :thumbsup: also we should probably file a tiny vendor ticket so the facilities team knows about the foreign storage in the machine.
Noah Patel: filed SUP-espresso-001 (j/k). if this turns into an incident I'll nominate it for the year-end lore book.
Ava Martinez: fine, but only if we can put the meme on the first page. :trophy:
